name: Compagnie Financière Richemont SA
summary: Compagnie Financière Richemont SA, an investment holding company, engages in the luxury goods business. The company operates through Jewellery Maisons, Specialist Watchmakers, and Other segments. It is involved in the design, manufacture, and distribution of jewelry products, precision timepieces, watches, writing instruments, clothing, and leather goods and accessories. The company provides its products under the Cartier, Van Cleef & Arpels, Vhernier, Buccellati, A.
